comment: The fixture store for the worldline cases: synthetic memories in the same spirit as bench/fixtures (publishable, nothing from any real house). Seed a fresh store with `distill_kura.worldline.seed(store, path)` and every shipped case is runnable. description = the index line the resident map is woven from, so it is what the agent recognizes by. tags 'superseded' marks a memory the house threw away.
